================================================================================
Higher-precedence raw token still wins over the guarded keyword
:cst
================================================================================
othermatchbox
---
0:0  - 0:13   program
0:0  - 0:13     raw_statement
0:0  - 0:5        raw `other`
0:5  - 0:13       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Optional digit belongs to the higher-precedence raw token
:cst
================================================================================
other1matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:14   program
0:0  - 0:14     raw_statement
0:0  - 0:6        raw `other1`
0:6  - 0:14       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Separate raw token and word
:cst
================================================================================
other box
---
0:0 - 0:9   program
0:0 - 0:9     raw_statement
0:0 - 0:5       raw `other`
0:6 - 0:9       word `box`

================================================================================
Unrelated word is not affected
================================================================================
value
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Raw token cannot replace its required following word
:error
================================================================================
other
---
(ERROR (raw))
